svg.title: diff of first and second: the two trees walked side by side, entries with the same name on both sides passed over unopened
svg.text: bin/git diff main~2 main~1: the two top trees, walked in step, entry by entry

g.title: diff reads the two top trees, dcd4984 and 6f0dd63, and walks their entries side by side in git's order, as a merge of two sorted lists.
g.text: the top trees differ, so the walk starts inside them

g.title: b c: the same blob, 9495c3c, on both sides: passed over. Equal names, equal bytes.
g.text: diff: b c: 9495c3c on both sides: the same, passed over

g.title: b/ is 1933da3 on both sides: the same tree, so the same everything under it. Passed over, never opened: c is not read at all.
g.text: diff: b/: 1933da3 on both sides: the same, passed over

g.title: d/ is d61f885 here and 7ecc4e4 there: something under it differs. Both trees are opened and walked in step, the same way.
g.text: diff: d/: d61f885 and 7ecc4e4: different, opened

g.title: d/e/: 8588183 against cd21a79. Different again: opened.
g.text: diff: d/e/: 8588183 and cd21a79: different, opened

g.title: d/e/f.txt: blob 4cdb226 against 06654ae: a changed file. Its two blobs are read later, to print the patch with module 06's diff.
d/g.txt: 01058d8 on both sides: passed over.
g.text: diff: d/g.txt: 01058d8 on both sides: the same, passed over

g.title: hello.txt: ce01362 on both sides: passed over. Done: 6 trees read, 1 subtree and 3 files passed over, 1 file changed.
g.text: diff: hello.txt: ce01362 on both sides: the same, passed over
